channel.title: Morning Brief — Australia Edition
channel.description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
channel.itunes:author: Rogineh

item.title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 10 October 2026
item.description: A spike in trading-card thefts prompting shops to tighten security and the ATO pressing ahead with its credit card payment ban, Queensland's latest Residential Activation Fund round for Toowoomba and the Lockyer Valley, plus the final days of HOTA's White Rabbit Collection exhibition on the Gold Coast. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

item.title: Morning Brief — Friday, 9 October 2026
item.description: The new AusAlert emergency warning system and federal funding for 100,000 new homes, Rockhampton's Customs House conservation project and a new round of Destination 2045 ecotourism funding, plus fresh figures on the Gold Coast's fast-outpacing population growth. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.

item.title: Morning Brief — Thursday, 8 October 2026
item.description: Rising coffee prices after the card surcharge ban and a national crackdown on illegal tobacco shops, Queensland's own tobacco blitz boosting legal sales and Logan's halved granny flat charge, plus a record 14.7 million visitors to the Gold Coast and the return of the Groundwater Country Music Festival. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
